text:
oncall-bot: AUTOMATED PAGE -> high sustained TPM for model family 'orion-ensemble' in us-west-2. 95p latency breaches, error rate rising. root=3742000000

maya: picking this up, looking at dashboards now.

alex: seeing a big uptick in short calls with function-calling enabled. 95p ~2.1s, error rate +0.3%. Most traffic from a handful of tenants.

priya: can we do a targeted per-family throttle + disable funcall temporarily? that'll reduce CPU pressure quickly.

jordan: propose surgical changes: lower TPM from 120k -> 30k, RPM 2000 -> 600 for orion-ensemble, disable function_calling and streaming for that family, and route a fraction to orion-ensemble-lite as fallback.

maya: run the commands below when ready. I'll watch the rollout.

alex: executing now...
```
# reduce rates for model family
rbctl quota update --family orion-ensemble --tpm 30000 --rpm 600 --reason "live mitigation 3742000000"
# disable funcall for family
rbctl feature-flag set --family orion-ensemble --flag function_calling --value false
# set fallback routing (20% to lite variant)
rbctl routing set --model-family orion-ensemble --fallback orion-ensemble-lite --weight 0.2
```

alex: quota update completed, propagated to edge (~20s). feature-flag change applied, funcall traffic dropped ~95%. routing change in progress.

priya: good. streaming still shows a small long tail — might be in-flight sessions or older SDKs. recommend also capping per-tenant burst for top consumers.

cara: from CS: acct-42 and acct-99 reported degraded outputs (shorter replies) after fallback kicked in. they're asking if this is expected and ETA for full restoration.

jordan: noted. we've prioritized stabilization first. we'll offer acct-42 a brief note and follow-up once we have timeline.

alex: applied tenant cap for acct-42 and acct-99 to limit blast radius:
```
rbctl tenant cap set --tenant acct-42 --model-family orion-ensemble --rpm 50 --reason "mitigation 3742000000"
rbctl tenant cap set --tenant acct-99 --model-family orion-ensemble --rpm 50 --reason "mitigation 3742000000"
```

alex: monitoring metrics -> 95p latency improved to ~600ms within 90s of changes. error rate back to baseline. fallback quality lower for some prompts, visible in CS reports.

maya: thanks. scheduling a formal handoff in 20m. @liam will you take the next oncall window and continue monitoring customer escalations & rollback plan?

liam: will take it. I'll validate rollback steps and confirm when safe to restore funcall and RPM/TMP. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled -> liam at 3742001200. Incident severity lowered to S2, keeping channel open for follow-ups.

priya: post-incident action items: 1) add funcall QPS by model metric, 2) add per-family funcall disable threshold & automated throttle, 3) review SDK behavior for streaming during routing changes, 4) run a cost analysis of funcall CPU for orion vs lite variant.

maya: creating ticket for follow-ups and a brief customer-facing note for acct-42/99.

jordan: once liam confirms stability, we'll gradually raise RPM/TMP to safe levels and re-enable function_calling in a staged rollout (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

liam: got it. will report status in this thread after 30m checks.

maya: thanks team. closing active mitigation once liam confirms. :white_check_mark:
